notes.title: The game now would remember your leaderboard name.
notes.notes: The game now would remember your leaderboard name. So you don't need to re-enter it every time.

notes.title: Some FAQ
notes.notes:
How to control?
The game support mouse/touch screen, keyboard and controllers.
There is a How To Play section in game for more details.

How to set resolution?
The game will detect your screen resolution. 
Because of a stupid design choice I made, if you want to play the game in full screen, your screen need to be in 9:16 portrait mode. Sorry about this.

How to make bullets more obvious?
The game have in-game filters. You can choose the one you like in the pause panel.

notes.title: Added a confirm panel when restart/menu button is pressed.
notes.notes:
Hi, one of my friend told me that he always accidently press restart key, losing the score. 
So I added a confirm panel.
Hope you enjoy the game.
